title_candidates: Claude Opus 4.8 adds an effort control you can test today
summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 with better reliability on difficult work and a new effort control that lets users trade speed for deeper reasoning.

primary_source.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.8
primary_source.author: Anthropic
key_facts: Opus 4.8 was released on May 28 as an upgrade to Opus 4.7.
Claude now provides an effort control on all plans.
Opus 4.8 is available to Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users.

steps.instruction: Open Claude and compare the same bounded review task at lower and higher effort settings.

risk_flags: Anthropic performance and reliability claims are vendor-reported.
